notes.title: 1.0g - New UI, Dash change, Bug fixes
notes.notes:
[h3]Others[/h3]
[list]
[*]Rework of the UI/UX for the levelup and 3D printer screen
[*]The dash direction is now using the player movement direction instead of the player targeting direction
[*]Reduced the price of the first 2 levels of the perk giving rerolls on level up (from 2500 & 4000 to 1000 & 2500)
[*]The game is now running even if the game window is out of focus
[*]Rephrased the description of the healing drone
[*]Increased the Air Strike OMG laser's speed
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue making the achievements unlocked not shown at the end of a run, so you couldn't see when a character was unlocked!
[*]Fixed an issue with the Healing and Support drones leaving off into the sunsets at some point in Stardust's runs
[*]Fixed an issue where the rank shown at the end of a run would be the old one. (The new rank wasn't updated on the Steam Leaderboards yet)
[*]Fixed the Shotgun OMG description (it was still indicating the old effect)
[*]Fixed a few typos
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0b - Framerate limit + Bug fixes
notes.notes:
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the accessibility settings were reset between runs
[*]Fixed a bug where a sound effect kept playing while selecting a button on the level-up screen
[*]Fixed a bug with the Machine Gun OMG causing a lot of errors, impacting the framerate
[/list]

[h3]Others[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added an option to limit the framerate in the settings (It is set by default to your screen refresh rate)
[/list]

[h3]Known issue[/h3]
[list]
[*]There's an issue with unsupported characters with the font I'm using on the leaderboards, showing a bunch of squares instead of names. I'm gonna look into setting up a backup font in the next patch!
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0a - First patch!
notes.notes:
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the locked icon for the 2nd map wasn't showing properly
[*]Fixed a bug where a character with a hat was scamming 1 reroll, he's not giving them back, sorry
[*]Fixed a bug where the achievement "[b]It flies![/b]" wouldn't be unlocked under certain circonstances
[*]Fixed a bug where the achievement "[b]Team Player[/b]" was given by mistake
[/list]
[h3]Others[/h3]
[list]
[*]Renamed the Stardust Leaderboards to Stardust (Endless)
[*]Added a little tutorial text when you only have one crewmate to choose from on Stardust
[*]Slightly changed the title text of the 3D printers. 
[/list]
[h3]Known issues[/h3]
[list]
[*]Sometimes the sound effect for an UI selection will get stuck on repeat during a level-up
[*]Sometimes the sound effect for enemy hits says no and leave
[/list]
